title: Building the Tower of Babel
image_prompt: Vast plain of Shinar: thousands of ancient laborers hoisting kiln-fired clay bricks and black bitumen mortar, constructing a colossal spiraling ziggurat tower reaching high toward dramatic clouds, bustling ancient construction site.

title: The Confusion of Tongues
image_prompt: Scattered workers on the unfinished terraces of Babel, throwing hands in confusion and inability to understand one another, dropped trowels and carts, families gathering belongings to scatter into the horizon under stormy skies.

title: Journey from Ur to Haran
image_prompt: Terah, Abram, and Sarai leading a desert caravan of laden camels, livestock, and woven black goat-hair tents across the arid Euphrates plains toward the hills of Haran at sunset.

title: The Call of Abram
image_prompt: Abram, a dignified Hebrew patriarch with dark graying beard and weathered noble features in rustic linen robes, standing on a desert ridge at brilliant dawn, looking out with resolute faith toward Canaan.

title: Altar at Shechem
image_prompt: Abram kneeling in humble prayer before a newly built rough-hewn stone altar under the great leafy oak tree of Moreh, white smoke curling up into a sunlit sky.

title: Abram and Sarai in Egypt
image_prompt: Abram and Sarai arriving before the colossal carved sandstone pylons and towering obelisks of ancient Egypt during famine, Pharaoh's royal guards in bronze armor observing their caravan.

title: Strife Among the Herdsmen
image_prompt: Heated argument between rugged shepherds over crowded desert grazing pastures and water cisterns, while Abram and younger nephew Lot stand nearby overlooking the valley, discussing peace.

title: Lot Chooses the Jordan Plain
image_prompt: Lot gazing down from high rocky cliffs toward the lush, emerald, well-watered valley of the Jordan River, pointing his caravan toward the distant gleaming city walls of Sodom.

title: The Promise of the Land at Hebron
image_prompt: Abram standing atop the heights of Hebron with arms outstretched, golden divine radiance illuminating the land in all four cardinal directions (north, south, east, and west) beneath the ancient terebinth trees.

title: Battle of the Valley of Siddim
image_prompt: Dynamic ancient battlefield near boiling tar pits of the Dead Sea: bronze-armored Mesopotamian kings clashing with the armies of Sodom, chaotic dust and captured plunder, Lot being taken captive.

title: Abram Rescues Lot
image_prompt: Nighttime military ambush: Abram and his 318 trained warrior-servants charging with raised spears, shields, and torches into the enemy encampment, liberating Lot and the captured families.

title: Melchizedek Blesses Abram
image_prompt: Melchizedek, majestic King of Salem in regal white and gold priestly vestments, presenting a wooden chalice of wine and unleavened bread to victorious Abram, who bows his head in sacred blessing outside ancient Salem.

title: The Starry Host Covenant
image_prompt: Abram standing outside his desert tent under a breathtaking, sprawling midnight sky filled with billions of sparkling stars and milky way nebulae, face upturned in profound belief and reverence.

title: The Smoking Firepot and Blazing Torch
image_prompt: Supernatural night scene: divided sacrificial offerings on stone slabs, deep eerie twilight, a glowing smoking firepot and a blazing torch of pure divine fire miraculously gliding between the pieces.

title: Sarai and Hagar
image_prompt: Interior of a decorated Bedouin tent: solemn Sarai wrapped in linen shawl presenting her young Egyptian handmaiden Hagar to a thoughtful Abram, subtle emotional gravity and silence.

title: The Angel at the Desert Spring
image_prompt: Weeping Hagar kneeling by a solitary water spring in the desolate rocky wilderness of Shur, looking up in awe at the radiant, comforting Angel of the Lord standing beside the oasis.

title: The Birth of Ishmael
image_prompt: Hagar gently cradling newborn baby Ishmael wrapped in woven swaddling cloth outside a desert encampment, elderly Abram watching warmly under warm afternoon shade.

title: Covenant of Abraham
image_prompt: Abraham, now an elderly patriarch of ninety-nine years with white beard, falling prostrate with his face to the ground before a brilliant divine golden glory that fills the scene, establishing the eternal covenant.

title: The Promise of Isaac
image_prompt: Abraham laughing with joyous astonishment on his knees, hands clasped, hearing the divine declaration that ninety-year-old Sarah shall bear a promised son named Isaac.

title: The Three Holy Visitors at Mamre
image_prompt: Abraham bowing low to the ground outside his tent door beneath the great terebinth oaks of Mamre, eagerly welcoming three luminous, serene heavenly travelers clad in simple pristine travelers' garments.

title: Sarah Listens from the Tent
image_prompt: Close interior shot: elderly Sarah standing in tent entrance shadows, gently holding aside the woven curtain, softly smiling in disbelief as the divine visitors speak the prophecy of Isaac.

title: Abraham Pleads for Sodom
image_prompt: Abraham standing alone with the Lord on a high rocky cliff overlook at dramatic sunset, hands lifted in passionate, solemn intercession as distant shadowy towers of Sodom loom far below.

title: The Angels Strike the Mob with Blindness
image_prompt: Nighttime courtyard at Lot's sturdy wooden doorway: two angelic messengers radiating blinding supernatural white light that flashes outward, striking a chaotic, wicked mob with sudden confusion and blindness.

title: Fleeing the City of Destruction
image_prompt: Angels urgently gripping the hands of Lot, his wife, and two daughters, pulling them at a desperate sprint through the dark sandstone city gates into the open desert before the break of dawn.

title: Fire from Heaven and the Pillar of Salt
image_prompt: Cataclysmic judgment: sky raining terrifying sheets of brimstone, sulfur, and molten fire consuming the city of Sodom, while on the foreground desert slope Lot's wife looks back and solidifies into a tragic pillar of pale salt.

title: Abraham Views the Smoke of the Plain
image_prompt: Abraham standing at sunrise on the high rocky lookout where he had interceded, looking down in sorrow at the entire valley smothered in thick, dark billowing smoke rising like a giant industrial furnace.

title: God Warns Abimelech in a Dream
image_prompt: Philistine palace bedroom in Gerar: King Abimelech bolting upright on his ornate couch in terror during a powerful divine nighttime dream vision, divine light piercing the royal chamber.

title: Abraham Prays for Abimelech
image_prompt: Courtyard of Gerar: Abimelech respectfully restoring Sarah to Abraham alongside gifts of silver, sheep, and oxen, while Abraham lifts his hands to heaven in prayer of healing over the royal household.
